data.name: Ramgopal
data.gender_notes: Ramgopal is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ram means God and Gopal means one who protects. Ramgopal thus signifies the footsteps of God or God in human form, protecting and guiding the devotee. The name Ramgopal carries the meaning “God's footsteps” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Ramgopal usually hope their child will grow to embody god's footsteps and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for the divine manifestation of God as a protector and guide.
data.etymology: Ramgopal belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's footsteps.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ramgopal total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_sanskrit.name: Gopal
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Gopal is a name derived from the Sanskrit words 'Gau' (cow) and 'Pal' (protector). It means 'protector of cows' or 'cowherd'. In Hindu mythology, Lord Krishna is often depicted as Gopal, as he is believed to have protected the cows and the villagers of Vrindavan.

data.cultural_impact: The name Ramgopal is a popular one in the Hindu culture, especially in North India. It is traditionally given to boys as a name that is believed to invoke God's blessings and protection. The name reflects the deep spiritual and devotional values ingrained in the Hindu culture, which places immense importance on seeking God's blessings and guidance in every aspect of life.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hinduism, Ram is considered as an incarnation of God, especially represented through the epic Ramayana. Gopal, on the other hand, signifies a protector or one who nurtures and cares for his people. The combination of these two names represents the belief in God as the ultimate protector and caretaker of his devotees. The spiritual significance of the name Ramgopal lies in its reminder of God's presence and protection, providing comfort and strength to the devotee in times of need.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Ramgopal: In Hinduism, 'Ram' signifies the divine essence of God, while 'Gopal' denotes the protector of the people. The name Ramgopal thus embodies the idea of God as the eternal protector and guide.
